fusions.name: Ink Speck
fusions.desc: Flicks a leaping speck of ink into the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Infested Shelf
fusions.desc: Shakes a swarm of booklice off your pages that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each one [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit hop to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Flip-Book Hop
fusions.desc: Flicks you through the pages to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Skipped Page
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
